title: Bounded operational check value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, and let $T$ be a table assigning to each vertex a function from the $q$-dimensional sign cube to $[-1,1]$. Fix a vertex $v$ and a sign query check consisting of a Boolean predicate on sign inputs and one cube query for each input position. The bounded operational check value is the expected randomized value of the predicate when each position independently samples a uniformly random neighbor of $v$, using the twisted table value at the neighbor and the queried coordinate, together with the corresponding bounded table value at the permuted query.
